newsitem.title: USA: IVI Publishing licenses medical guidebook.
newsitem.headline: IVI Publishing licenses medical guidebook.

text.p: IVI Publishing Inc said Tuesday it granted a license for the digital version of The Medical Advisor to Oxford Health Plans Inc, which will make the product available to the more than 1.5 million Oxford members via Internet access.

Under the terms of the agreement, Oxford will pay for non-exclusive rights to information from IVI's digital version of The Medical Advisor, a medical guidebook offering information on common medical ailments and conventional and alternative treatment options.
IVI has the exclusive electronic publishing rights to the content of The Medical Advisor.
IVI is an electronic publisher of interactive, multimedia health and medical information.
